items.title: Pinned formal proof reproduction and axiom audit
items.enables: Rebuild a Lean theorem against a pinned upstream commit and audit proof holes, axioms, and SHA-256
items.reuse_context: Formal verification projects requiring auditable, reproducible evidence
items.evidence: Public reproducibility script pins baseline commit and proof hash, runs lake build, checks sorry/admit/custom axiom, and prints theorem axioms; project README reports successful public CI, but no fresh run performed during this scan.
requirements: Git, Lean/elan, Lake, network, Linux shell
limitations: Runs a destructive rm -rf of configured working directory; use isolated scratch path
Certifies the narrow temporal closure result only, not full Navier-Stokes blowup

items.title: Recursive prompt-only symbolic planning benchmark harness
items.enables: Run graded symbolic-planning puzzles with per-run histories and correction prompts
items.reuse_context: Benchmark harnesses for structured reasoning and solver recovery
items.evidence: Source iterates graded puzzle rounds, accumulates token counts, and injects a failure-correction prompt after consecutive failures; README claims results but no benchmark was rerun.
requirements: OpenAI API access, puzzle grader modules, API cost approval
limitations: README outcome claims unverified in this inventory
Model/API behavior and costs may change

items.title: Percolation and graph reachability correlation experiment
items.enables: Sweep random graph edge-retention values and compare reachable-node fraction with betweenness centrality
items.reuse_context: Network fragility simulations and graph-analysis prototypes
items.evidence: Public script implements event_gravity_index, percolation_experiment, and CSV output; study metrics are author-reported and were not independently reproduced.

items.title: Single-fit symbolic residual Monte Carlo ROC benchmark
items.enables: Compare change-point detection scores across simulated step magnitudes using a fixed symbolic-regression baseline, Monte Carlo samples, ROC curves, and power at a specified false-positive rate
items.reuse_context: Prototype benchmarking of noisy time-series change detectors
items.evidence: Public source fixes RNG seed, fits PySR once on null data, simulates null/step series, computes residual scores and ROC/AUC, and exports plots. No execution or CI result was verified during this inventory.
requirements: Python, numpy, matplotlib, scipy, scikit-learn, PySR and its runtime dependencies
limitations: Synthetic Gaussian series only; real-world detection validity not established
Score normalizer multiplies median_abs_deviation(scale='normal') by 1.4826 again; review calibration before relying on scores
Uses a shared null-fitted model; assess evaluation leakage and repeated-sample independence before reuse

items.title: Seeded synthetic sliding-window event-rate visualization
items.enables: Generate reproducible synthetic sliding-window rate deviations with an injected time-localized signal and export annotated plots
items.reuse_context: Teaching, plot prototyping, and synthetic event-rate visualization
items.evidence: Public Python source sets numpy seed 42, creates 39-day window-center dates, samples Gaussian baseline deviations, injects a Gaussian-shaped time-localized enhancement, and saves PDF/PNG plots. Not executed during scan.
limitations: Data are explicitly synthetic, not actual LIGO detection-rate observations
Overlapping window labels do not establish an empirical 39-day event-count calculation
No physical correlation or causal inference is supported by this generator
